Utopia on BNB Chain was exploited on July 20, 2023 by means of a business logic flaw in its token-pair airdrop and liquidity logic, resulting in a loss of approximately $119,300 (492 BNB). The attacker manipulated the airdrop mechanism to reset the liquidity pair’s token balance and drained the paired asset. The root cause was a flaw in Utopia’s airdrop logic, which allowed the attacker to set the liquidity pair’s Utopia token balance to 1 by predicting or controlling the airdrop recipient. This enabled reserves manipulation and extraction of assets via swaps.
